notes.title: Chumini: Tiny Army | Demo Update 0.4.23
notes.notes: [p]Hello there![/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a [b]fresh update[/b] that makes building your tiny army feel smoother, snappier, and even more satisfying. Here's what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Upgrade UI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Icons[/b]: Each statistic now has its own shiny icon to help you strategize at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smooth Animations[/b]: We’ve added sleek transitions and effects to make navigating upgrades feel more dynamic and rewarding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New "recap" screen:[/b] there's now an updated recap screen (that you can access in the pause menu) with live key stats from you current game[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Minor tweaks across several upgrades and enemies to keep things fun, fair, and challenging.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is part of our ongoing mission to polish the core loop and make every run a joy to play. Thanks as always for your support and feedback, keep it coming![/p][p][/p][p][b]Now go forth and grow that tiny army! ✨[/b][/p]

notes.title: Chumini: Tiny Army | Playtest Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey eveyone! Thank you very much for all the support, kind words and feedback regarding the playtest version of Chumini!  💖 
We just released an update to fix some issues, and to add missing stuff into the game.

[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Final boss is no longer one-shotable
[*] Final waves are less difficult, and spawn less projectile-based enemies
[*] Altruistics, Sads and Lonelies are now slightly nerfed
[*] There are now 10 levels of difficulty
[/list]

[b]Bugs & fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed typos in several Chuminis Upgrade descriptions
[*] Altruistics freeze duration now scale with the levels as intended
[/list]

[b]QoL improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a choice to disable screenshakes in the Options menu
[*] Added a choice to disable chromatic aberration in the Options menu
[*] Chumini damages in recap screen are now separated in "Contact damage" and "Ability damage" for more clarity
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a different music for the 5 first minutes of playthrough, because the previous one was getting too repetitive
[*] Added names of peoples who answered the playtest google form in the credits
[/list]

notes.title: Chumini: Tiny Army | Playtest version is NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
[b]Help us to figure out what can be improved in our game Chumini: Tiny Army![/b]

[b]Chumini: Tiny Army is a cute & short survivor-like[/b], in which you summon colorful tiny creatures instead of your traditional weapons and spells. You have to survive waves of sylvan demons for 20 minutes!

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*] A cast of colorful Chuminis to play with!
[*] Keyboard and controler supported.
[*] Meta-progression in-between runs to progress further each try.
[*] Difficulty levels to unlock.
[*] A passionate team, waiting for your feedbacks! ❤
[/list]

After playing, you'll be able to fill up a [b]google form[/b] in order to give us your feedbacks! If you want to help us and that you have some free time, please consider it! It'll help us a lot!

And have fun! 😊
